mapper.select: select from FINANCINGSYS.EAS_VOUCHER_HEAD where PERIODYEAR=#{periodYear} and PERIODMONTH=#{periodMonth} and to_char(FINANCIALDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{voucherDate} and EASBZCODE is not null order by create_date asc

SELECT TO_char(evh.BZDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') business_date, TO_char(evh.FINANCIALDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') voucher_date, evh.VOUCHERNUMBER as voucher_number, evh.SYSTEM_ system_code, evh.MODELNAME scene_name, evh.ORGNUMBER org_id, evh.CONTRACTID contract_code, eve.ACCOUNTNUMBER account_code, eve.DEBITAMOUNT debit_amount, eve.CREDITAMOUNT credit_amount FROM FINANCINGSYS.EAS_VOUCHER_HEAD evh,FINANCINGSYS.EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY eve WHERE evh.VOUCHERNUMBER =eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID AND evh.PERIODYEAR = #{periodYear} AND evh.PERIODMONTH = #{periodMonth} AND TO_char(evh.BZDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')=#{voucherDate} order by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

SELECT TO_char(evh.BZDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') business_date, TO_char(evh.FINANCIALDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') voucher_date, evh.VOUCHERNUMBER as voucher_number, evh.SYSTEM_ system_code, evh.MODELNAME scene_name, evh.ORGNUMBER org_id, evh.CONTRACTID contract_code, eve.ACCOUNTNUMBER account_code, eve.DEBITAMOUNT debit_amount, eve.CREDITAMOUNT credit_amount, eva.ASSTACTTYPENAME asstact_type_name, eva.ASSTACTNUMBER asstact_number, eva.AMOUNT amount FROM EAS_VOUCHER_HEAD evh LEFT OUTER JOIN EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY eve ON evh.VOUCHERNUMBER =eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN EAS_VOUCHER_ASSTACT EVA ON eva.EAS_VOUCHER_ID =eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID AND eva.EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY_ID =eve.ENTRYSEQ AND eva.ASSTACTTYPE ='002' WHERE evh.PERIODYEAR = #{periodYear} AND evh.PERIODMONTH = #{periodMonth} AND TO_char(evh.BZDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd')=#{voucherDate} order by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7

select evh.BZDATE businessDate, evh.FINANCIALDATE voucherDate, evh.VOUCHERNUMBER voucherNumber, evh.EASFLAG easFlag, evh.id_ easbzCode, evh.CREATE_DATE createDate, evh.SYSTEM_ systemCode, evh.MODELNAME sceneName, evh.ORGNUMBER orgId, eve.ACCOUNTNUMBER accountCode, eve.currencynumber currencyNumber, eve.DEBITAMOUNT debitAmount, eve.CREDITAMOUNT creditAmount, eve.voucherabstract voucherAbstract, eva1.ASSTACTNUMBER contractCode, eva2.ASSTACTNUMBER clientCode, eva3.ASSTACTNUMBER ebankNo from EAS_VOUCHER_HEAD evh inner join EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY eve on evh.VOUCHERNUMBER = eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID left outer join EAS_VOUCHER_ASSTACT EVA1 on eva1.EAS_VOUCHER_ID = eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID and eva1.EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY_ID = eve.ENTRYSEQ and eva1.ASSTACTTYPENAME = '合同号' left outer join EAS_VOUCHER_ASSTACT EVA2 on eva2.EAS_VOUCHER_ID = eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID and eva2.EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY_ID = eve.ENTRYSEQ and eva2.ASSTACTTYPENAME = '客户' left outer join EAS_VOUCHER_ASSTACT EVA3 on eva3.EAS_VOUCHER_ID = eve.EAS_VOUCHER_ID and eva3.EAS_VOUCHER_ENTRY_ID = eve.ENTRYSEQ and eva3.ASSTACTTYPENAME = '银行账户' where evh.system_ in ('GAXT', 'HY-XDWL') and evh.ORGNUMBER in ('01-C0001', '02-C0001', '30001', '80001') and evh.modelname not in('已开票增值税发票回导') and evh.PERIODYEAR = #{year} and evh.PERIODMONTH = #{month} and TO_char(evh.FINANCIALDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')= #{voucherDate} order by EVH.VOUCHERNUMBER, EVH.CREATE_DATE , EVA1.ASSTACTNUMBER
